newsitem.title: USA: Wife of Olympic official waives court appearance.
newsitem.headline: Wife of Olympic official waives court appearance.

text.p: The wife of an influential member of the International Olympic Committee waived a court appearance on Monday on charges that she kneed an Atlanta police officer in the groin during the Olympic Games.

Julie Pound, the wife of Canadian IOC vice president Dick Pound, did not appear in court. Her attorney, Jim Martin, waived arraignment during a traffic court hearing. A trial date was not immediately set.

Pound was charged with refusing to comply with an officer's orders, obstruction, disorderly conduct and simple battery after the July 30 incident. Officer Leanne Browning said a drunken Pound used foul language after ignoring repeated warnings that she and her husband were jaywalking.
Pound's husband headed the IOC Coordination Commission which oversaw planning for the Atlanta Games.
